headline: Belrise Industries Limited: Board Meeting — Q1 FY2026–27 Results, Dividend, Share Capital Increase
sum: Belrise Industries filed Q1 FY2026–27 unaudited standalone and consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, recommended a final dividend of ₹0.55 per equity share (11%) for FY2025–26, and sought shareholder approval to increase authorised share capital from ₹500 crore to ₹550 crore.
implication: The capital increase signals headroom for future QIP or equity issuance; the 11% dividend payout ratio on a likely modest Q1 result suggests stable cash generation post-QIP dilution, warranting review of the equity issuance documentation and QIP terms.
detail: Belrise Industries' Board approved Q1 FY2026–27 unaudited results (standalone and consolidated) with an unmodified audit opinion and issued a limited review report. The company recommended a final dividend of ₹0.55 per share at 11% on equity shares issued under a completed Qualified Institutional Placement (QIP), contingent on AGM approval. In parallel, the Board approved a ₹50 crore increase in authorised share capital (from ₹500 cr to ₹550 cr, i.e., from 10 crore to 11 crore shares of ₹5 par each) subject to shareholder vote at the AGM. The Board also appointed M/s Rajput and Associates (Registration No. 1) as the Company's Cost Accountant.
